react.description:
A single destination inside a `NavigationRail`; renders as a link when
`href` is provided, otherwise as a button.

tags.devx:
- Selection is index-based and provided by the parent rail.
- `extendedOnly` hides items when the rail is collapsed.
- The label reveal (width/height + opacity, on `extended` changes) is
  driven by a shared `@udixio/core/dom` Motion controller, the same one
  the Angular adapter uses.
tags.a11y:
- Exposes `aria-current="page"` when selected, since the rail is a
  navigation landmark rather than a tabbed panel switcher.
tags.limitations:
- No arrow-key navigation between items; relies on the native sequential
  tab order (a roving tabindex is only required for `tablist`/`listbox`
  widgets, which this is not).

className.name: className
className.description: Classes or state-aware element classes applied through the shared style contract.

selected.name: selected
selected.description: Controlled selected state, used when no parent drives the selection.

variant.name: variant
variant.description: Injected by the parent NavigationRail: layout direction of the item.

index.name: index
index.description: Injected by the parent NavigationRail: position of this item in the rail.

selectedItem.name: selectedItem
selectedItem.description: Injected by the parent NavigationRail: index of the currently selected item.

isExtended.name: isExtended
isExtended.description: Injected by the parent NavigationRail: whether the rail is extended.

extendedOnly.name: extendedOnly
extendedOnly.description: Injected by the parent NavigationRail: hide the item while the rail is collapsed.

angular.description:
A single destination inside a `udx-navigation-rail`; renders as a link
when `href` is provided, otherwise as a button.

tags.devx:
- Selection is index-based and resolved from the parent rail; standalone
  usage falls back to `selected`.
- An item placed after a `udx-navigation-rail-section` only renders while
  the rail is extended.
- The label reveal (width/height + opacity, on `extended` changes) is
  driven by a shared `@udixio/core/dom` Motion controller, the same one
  the React adapter uses.
tags.a11y:
- Exposes `aria-current="page"` when selected, since the rail is a
  navigation landmark rather than a tabbed panel switcher.
tags.limitations:
- No arrow-key navigation between items; relies on the native sequential
  tab order.

label.name: label
label.description: Text shown alongside (or as the accessible name for) the icon.

icon.name: icon
icon.description: Icon shown while the item is not selected.

iconSelected.name: iconSelected
iconSelected.description: Icon shown while the item is selected.

selected.name: selected
selected.description: Controlled selected state, used when no parent drives the selection.

href.name: href
href.description: Navigation destination; switches the inner element to a native link.
